1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than 2000 Da and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, __wherein said polyalkylenimine and polyanion are present in a molar ratio such that the polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle exhibits a predominance of positive charges or negative charges as controlled by the molar ratio__.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker, __wherein the multivalent cation crosslinker is present in an amount effective to modulate the charge density and size of the nanoparticle__.

3) (Original) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is polyethylenimine.

4) (Original) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and anionic surfactants.

5) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is a complexed zirconium compound selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, zirconium acetylacetonate, aluminum chloride, aluminum sulfate, aluminum citrate, tin chloride, tin sulfate, iron chloride, iron nitrate, titanium chloride, and titanium sulfate, __wherein said crosslinker is present in an amount of less than 10 molar percent relative to the polyanion__.

6) (Original) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium or calcium ions.

8) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex comprised a nanoparticle with an average particle size of about 100 to 900 nm in diameter, __wherein the particle size is achieved through control of the molar ratio of polyalkylenimine to polyanion__.

9) (Original) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticles are stable in water, field brine and seawater.

10) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS), said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, __wherein the polyalkylenimine and PVS are present in a molar ratio that controls the charge density of the nanoparticle__.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a multivalent cation, __wherein the multivalent cation is present in an amount effective to crosslink and stabilize the polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle__.

13) (Original) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe or Al.

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer __having anionic functional groups__ that can be crosslinked with a); and c) a fluid.

22) (Original) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is an acrylate-based polymer.

23) (Original) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is partially hydrolyzed polyacrylamide.

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acrylamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acrylamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, __wherein the polymer has a molecular weight greater than 100 kDa__.

26) (Original) The composition of claim 21, where fluid is brine or seawater.
